title: Projektetage Inline Catalogue Labels
description: Bauteilbeschriftungen: three text dispositions on one line (Rippenplatte Unterzug Stütze). Many-to-one tile morph per column; tiles settle and morph position before embodiment switch.
summary:
Fixed no auto-animate between Bauteilarten (#/0/8) and Bauteilbeschriftungen (#/0/9).

Root causes: (1) morphParticipant column anchors were never rendered (skipped by interactive layout). (2) Tile→label swap relied only on presentation-arrangement--settled from slidechanged, but reveal runs auto-animate after slidechanged while dormant anchors stayed visibility:hidden so matcher had nothing to morph. (3) autoanimate event read sheet from event.data instead of reveal-extended event.sheet, so uniform-scale patch never applied.

Fixes: MorphParticipantArrangementSlots; morphFrom crop ghosts on three inline label dispositions; beforeslidechange + slideChangedEventSlides for settle timing; CSS swaps tiles→dormant anchors on data-auto-animate pending/running (and settled). Integration tests confirm matcher pairs catalogue-col1/2/3 figure→label and reveal fires autoanimate on full deck navigation.

61 renderer + 8 deck tests pass.
